_meta.purpose: Body fragments for the dialog. The dialog shell itself is the Dialog component and lives in patterns.json.
_meta.spacingModel: The Popover owns the spacing between header, body and footer via its Spacing variant. Inside the body, blocks sit at gap md. Do not add an extra wrapper just to create spacing.
_meta.shellModel: Header, body and footer are the Dialog's three Popover slots, not hand-built rows. A region without content is switched off, never rendered empty.
_meta.textFields: A `text` field MUST be named after the component's own TEXT property — a Notification carries "Headline" and "Text", a form control "Label" and "Placeholder". A field that matches nothing is a hard stop at render time, because the component would otherwise ship the library's default copy ("Headline") as if it were product copy.
_meta.placeholders: <Angle brackets> mark content the agent MUST replace. <Trailing?> marks an optional node: drop it when no content applies, never render it empty.

modal.question.purpose: The dialog's question or statement as a single body paragraph.

modal.consequence.purpose: Inline notification spelling out an irreversible or risky consequence.

modal.body.purpose: Dialog body: the question with an optional consequence notification.
